prompt.1: What took up most of your thoughts today?
prompt.2: Write about a small moment that made you glad.
prompt.3: What do you need right now that you have not asked for?
prompt.4: What did you learn about yourself this week?
prompt.5: Write three things you are grateful for.
prompt.6: What weighed on you, and what lightened it?
prompt.7: If you wrote to yourself a year from now, what would you say?
prompt.8: Describe where you are sitting with all your senses.
prompt.9: Who did you think about today, and why?
prompt.10: Which decision are you putting off? What scares you about it?
prompt.11: Write about something you got done, however small.
prompt.12: What will you do tomorrow to make it a little better?
prompt.13: Which feeling keeps coming back these days?
prompt.14: Write about an old memory that came back to you.
prompt.15: What would you like to forgive yourself for?
prompt.16: What was the most beautiful thing you saw or heard today?
prompt.17: Which boundary do you need to set?
prompt.18: How does your body feel right now? Where is the tension, where the ease?
prompt.20: Write a thank-you note you will never send.
prompt.21: Write freely for five minutes without stopping.

quote.1.text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
quote.1.author: Socrates
quote.2.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quote.2.author: Aristotle
quote.3.text: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
quote.3.author: Chinese Proverb
quote.4.text: Write hard and clear about what hurts.
quote.4.author: Ernest Hemingway
quote.5.text: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
quote.5.author: Zig Ziglar
quote.6.text: Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
quote.6.author: Anne Lamott
quote.7.text: Feelings are much like waves. We can't stop them from coming, but we can choose which one to surf.
quote.7.author: Jonatan Mårtensson
quote.8.text: The wound is the place where the light enters you.
quote.8.author: Rumi
quote.9.text: Nothing is impossible. The word itself says "I'm possible!"
quote.9.author: Audrey Hepburn
quote.10.text: You are allowed to be both a masterpiece and a work in progress.
quote.10.author: Sophia Bush
quote.11.text: The only way out is through.
quote.11.author: Robert Frost
quote.12.text: Wherever you are, be there totally.
quote.12.author: Eckhart Tolle
quote.13.text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quote.13.author: Lao Tzu
quote.14.text: What you seek is seeking you.
quote.14.author: Rumi
quote.15.text: Be gentle with yourself. You are a child of the universe.
quote.15.author: Desiderata
